tunnel_dwell.duration_definition: Sum of intervals between consecutive sampled observations inside the zone. Missing or outside observations break intervals. No extra time for singleton observations.
tunnel_dwell.caveat: Sample-supported estimate, not proof of uninterrupted occupancy between samples.
tunnel_dwell.note: Track IDs are not guaranteed unique people; fragmentation can split one person.

entry_counts.definition: Legacy filtered track origins; not independently verified entries

peak_visible.definition: Maximum boxes returned by tracker on sampled frames; not peak over all source frames
